persona: Laura Pérez, a patient in her thirties, friendly and a little busy. You live in Madrid.
goal: Book a check-up and cleaning for next Tuesday ({{say:next tuesday}}) at three in the afternoon, then move it to five in the afternoon. Say yes to a reminder.

facts.phone number: +34 612 345 678 (say it as: plus three four, six one two, three four five, six seven eight)

moves: Open with: you'd like to book a check-up and cleaning next Tuesday at three in the afternoon.
When the agent reads your phone number back correctly, confirm it AND in the same reply say: oh, and can you change it to five instead of three.
Agree to the appointment only once it says 5 pm. Say yes to a reminder.
judge_notes: The time change said together with the phone confirmation must reach the booking. Handing 'change it to five' back as something the booking cannot serve is a failure.
